description_blocks.text: Overview

Want to be the MVP of your next outdoor party, backyard water fight, or beach day? The CyberBrick Remote-Controlled Water Turret is your go-to for instant fun. Built with CyberBrick’s innovative modular components, this fully remote-controlled turret delivers nonstop action with 360° continuous rotation, adjustable vertical aiming, and an impressive water range of up to 7.5 meters. Designed for builders and players aged 13 and up, it’s easy to assemble, durable enough for outdoor use, and guaranteed to turn any gathering into a splash-filled highlight that everyone will want a turn with.
Find all files and details on its MakerWorld Page.
*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.
Shoot everywhere with no blind spots
Spin the turret endlessly to cover every angle, and adjust the barrel up and down for precise targeting.
Impressive 7.5-Meter Range
Blast water up to 7.5 meters away, outpacing ordinary water blasters and keeping you competitive even at long distances.
LED Firing Lights
Lights up when you shoot, making every splash feel more exciting and fun to watch.
2-Liter Integrated Water Tank

This built-in tank holds up to 2 liters of water and also acts as a counterbalance for smooth, stable turret movement. Its large capacity and dense print design help ensure reliable performance during extended play.
Hassle-Free Use
Includes a custom one-handed controller design and works seamlessly with the official Bambu controller using the default configuration.
You can even slip the controller into your pocket for stealthy operation so no one will guess who’s behind the splashes
Built for Outdoor Adventures
Recommended to print with Bambu PETG HF for excellent weather resistance (tested with Bambu PLA Basic too), no need to worry about normal outdoor wear.
Use bright, non-realistic colors as a safety-first choice to make it clear this is a toy and avoid any confusion during water play.
Remote Control Instruction
The Model is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. Pre-configured settings have been prepared for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Important Notices
To ensure safety, please read and carefully follow the guidelines below. Minors must be under direct adult supervision when using this product.
Intended Users: This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
Firmware Safety: Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
Operational Safety: Do not touch the moving tracks or wheels while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
Battery & Charging: DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A, only the officially designated battery and charger must be used. Avoid exposing the battery to high temperatures or water.

Maintenance & Storage: Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.
Our company is not liable for any equipment damage, failure, fire, or other loss caused by non-compliance with the above requirements.
